world.title: White House denies Hegseth and Rubio to leave jobs after Republican election losses

world.title: Macau jails pro-democracy campaigner in city's first national security case

world.title: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse
world.description: The move follows a bank collapse and after the lower house of congress voted in favour of pursuing an impeachment trial against him.

world.title: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
world.description: At least 21 flights across Europe are affected in what the UK government calls a "malicious hoax threat".

world.title: French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living
world.description: The interior ministry estimates 600,000 people joined protests across France, while the unions say the number was far higher.

US.description: The Trump administration hoped to begin construction immediately after a federal panel approved its arch late Thursday. But just after midnight, the judge issued an order blocking work for 14 days.
